description: Quest Journal V3 multi-project prototype. Go Rin no Sho section and paragraph sequence from V4. Working English titles outside Earth Scroll; Python and other objective templates are illustrative. Optional procedures provide how-to guidance for Mathematics Makes Sense, without adding completion requirements.
